newsitem.title: CHINA: Worldbest completes issue of extra B shares.
newsitem.headline: Worldbest completes issue of extra B shares.

text.p: China's textile manufacturer Shanghai Worldbest, has successfully placed an additional 15 million B shares on top of the 100 million issued in July, a company official said on Monday.
Worldbest said it was the first Shanghai B share firm to take advantage of the right to issue an additional 15 percent of shares within one month if the initial offering is well received.
The extra share issue raised the company's total share capitalisation to 198.53 million shares from 183.53 million.
The additional shares were priced at $0.28, the same as the first batch, he said.
The impact of the additional share issue would be limited, though its net profit per share would fall slightly, the official said.
Trading in Shanghai Worldbest shares was suspended early in the session on the news. They closed at $0.300 on Monday, unchanged from last Friday's close.
